definitions.gloss: issuance, promulgation (of an order, warning, or official directive)
definitions.explanation: The official issuing of an order, warning, regulation, or directive by an authority.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{発令|はつれい}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：03019_hinan⟧⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：02703_meirei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発令|はつれい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{噴火|ふんか}→噴火：00045_funka⟧⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{発令|はつれい}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A volcanic eruption warning was issued.

notes:
{発令|はつれい} means to officially issue or promulgate something.

COMMON USAGE:
- {警報|けいほう}を{発令|はつれい}する: to issue a warning
- {命令|めいれい}を{発令|はつれい}する: to issue an order
- {発令|はつれい}される (passive): to be issued

RELATED:
- {発表|はっぴょう}: announcement, release (more general)
